steps.label: resolve-lock-pinned
command:
mkdir -p /out/tmp; set -e
mkdir -p /out/pinned-remotes
for spec in 'verus https://github.com/verus-lang/verus.git 781a460f35066e4bbc914b7fe3feb219ca9c850f' 'tla https://github.com/anvil-verifier/verus-tla e7eda3f24b60fbbf4396e623a06da9ec32512c0e'; do
    set -- $spec
    git init --bare /out/pinned-remotes/$1.git
    git -C /out/pinned-remotes/$1.git fetch --depth 1 $2 $3
    git -C /out/pinned-remotes/$1.git update-ref refs/heads/main $3
    git -C /out/pinned-remotes/$1.git symbolic-ref HEAD refs/heads/main
done
git config --global url.file:///out/pinned-remotes/verus.git.insteadOf https://github.com/verus-lang/verus.git
git config --global url.file:///out/pinned-remotes/tla.git.insteadOf https://github.com/anvil-verifier/verus-tla
cp Cargo.toml /out/resolution/Cargo.toml
cd /out/resolution
CARGO_NET_GIT_FETCH_WITH_CLI=true cargo +1.98.0 generate-lockfile
cp Cargo.lock /out/Cargo.lock
